subject: Operational checklist: DPA handoff & cross-border evidence cadence
messages:
From: Ellis Shaw <ellis.shaw@acmehealth.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, procurement@acmehealth.com
Date: Fri, 14 Nov 2025 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Evidence ask for DPA + cross-border scope

Hannah / procurement team —

Thanks for the quick onboarding call yesterday. To keep procurement on schedule we need a concise deliverable set that maps to our legal checklist. Key asks from Acme legal and procurement: 

- A current list of Redwood subprocessors and the locations where they process EU/UK data (CSV preferred).
- Confirmation of which transfer mechanisms we will rely on (SCCs + UK Addendum / IDTA) and any TIAs/DTIAs scoped to our account.
- Evidence that log-level exports/pseudonymization controls exist for exportability questions (sample S3 path or runbook).
- A proposed cadence for handing over artifacts to our security team so we can sign off before the end of November.

I've attached Acme's requirements matrix (acme_requirements_v3.pdf) to show the level of detail we need. Can Redwood commit to a 5-business-day turnaround for the subprocessors CSV + a proposed evidence handoff plan?

Appreciate it — Ellis

--
Ellis Shaw
Head of Procurement, Acme Health
ellis.shaw@acmehealth.com
+1 415-555-0192
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Ellis Shaw <ellis.shaw@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 14 Nov 2025 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Evidence ask for DPA + cross-border scope

Thanks Ellis — we can do that.

High-level response and next steps:

- Subprocessors snapshot: we'll generate a CSV export (redwood_subprocessors_snapshot.csv) with processing locations and contract status. Delivery: EOD Tuesday 18 Nov.
- Transfer mechanisms: Redwood proposes SCCs + UK Addendum (IDTA) as primary; we'll include a short mapping document showing where TIAs are required for specific third-party cache/edge providers.
- Exportability/logs: we will surface token-level audit examples and the S3 prefixes in a separate artifact.
- Handoff cadence: propose two checkpoints — 
  1) Technical artifact drop (CSV + example logs + mapping) by Tue 18 Nov
  2) Executive DPA & UK Addendum signoff packet (DocuSign link) by Fri 21 Nov if no major gaps.

Laura / Kimberly — can you review the TIA split (controls vs contract artifacts) and confirm whether we can share the token-audit sample or need an on-call demo? Also if DocuSign for the DPA is acceptable, legal can prepare the addendum text to circulate.

Attachments: redwood_subprocessors_snapshot.csv (placeholder)

Thanks,
Hannah
Director, Privacy & Compliance
Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 15 Nov 2025 08:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Evidence ask for DPA + cross-border scope

Hannah — good plan. A few operational clarifications from legal/privacy: 

- TIA/DTIA scoping: recommend we split artifacts into (A) contractual items (DPA + UK Addendum language, signed subprocessor attestations) and (B) operational evidence (logs, config snapshots, keystore attestations). Acme will need both.
- Sampling approach: Jordan, can your team produce a 7-day token-log sample and an S3 path for secure review? If we provide a limited read-only bucket and an access window, that should satisfy their technical team.
- Redlines & DocuSign: we will prepare the UK Addendum pre-filled with Acme as the counterparty; I will also prepare a short cover letter that summarizes the cross-border mechanisms and points to the TIAs.

I'll attach a short memo outlining what goes in the technical evidence bucket so we can be explicit with Acme (TIA_scoping_memo.docx).

Laura
Sr. Counsel, Privacy & Compliance
Redwood Inference

From: Ellis Shaw <ellis.shaw@acmehealth.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: Mariana Costa <mariana.costa@globemed.com>, procurement@acmehealth.com
Date: Sun, 16 Nov 2025 14:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Evidence ask for DPA + cross-border scope

Appreciate the rapid responses. A couple of clarifying asks from procurement & security: 

1) Timeline pressure — procurement needs the subprocessors CSV and a minimum set of artifacts by Tue 18 Nov to make the internal cutoff for our contract committee. If your EOD 18 Nov timeline holds we'll escalate to the committee with your packet.

2) Token-level exports — Acme security would prefer an export schema example showing how we can identify EU-origin sessions. Are token timestamps, region tags, or connection metadata included in your audit exports?

3) DocuSign & signoff — procurement prefers DocuSign for the DPA; please include a field for region-specific addendum acceptance (UK Addendum checkbox).

Also copying Mariana (our vendor manager) — Mariana, can you confirm whether you need an additional compliance questionnaire filled (we use the Galactic procurement portal)? Procurement link: https://procure.acmehealth.com/requests/ACME-REDWOOD-2025

Thanks — Ellis
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: Ellis Shaw <ellis.shaw@acmehealth.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 18 Nov 2025 16:40:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Evidence ask for DPA + cross-border scope

Ellis / team — quick operational reply and proposed workback (quoting above).

Workback plan (deliverables and owners):
- Tue 18 Nov EOD (Jordan): redwood_subprocessors_snapshot.csv + evidence_bucket_manifest.csv (list of artifacts we will place into a secure GDrive read-only folder).
- Wed 19 Nov (Jordan/Infra): 7-day token-log sample (redacted) staged in S3 with temporary read-only access. Will include region tags and connection metadata as requested.
- Thu 20 Nov (Laura): Draft DPA + pre-filled UK Addendum for Acme review; will add DocuSign checkbox for UK Addendum acceptance.
- Fri 21 Nov (Hannah): Executive summary packet + link to DocuSign for signatures.

Notes on token logs: we'll redact user identifiers and provide only the attributes required to demonstrate flow (timestamp, geo tag, model inference region, subprocessor hop). If Acme needs a live demo rather than files, we can schedule a 30-minute demo window on Thu 20 Nov.

DocuSign provisional link (will be enabled after legal review): https://www.docusign.com/ACME-Redwood-DPA

If procurement confirms that the Galactic portal questionnaire is required, Jordan please share the manifest in the portal as well.

Jordan Blake
Technical Program Manager, Ops Integrations
Redwood Inference
